note: `demo/pins/w` has two releases, "2021 - 2022" on class/kind/v1 and "2022 - 2023" on class/kind/v2, that share 2022. An order over 2021-2023 naming both gets 2022 twice, one entry per release with its own version, so that year carries two versions: one `classification_version_ambiguous` warning whose period is 2022 alone (crates/DESIGN.md, the findings rules; #2602). 2021 and 2023 have one version each and give no finding; the code lists are identical, so there is no `form_change`. The silent twin is `classification-versions`. Fails if the same-day check is deleted, if the warning's period is the hull 2021-2023, or if successive versions outside the shared year warn. Oracle: the fixture's JSONL releases and the two `set classification` statements.
